summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Defiance Memory & Photonics ETF (PRAM) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Solactive Memory and Photonics index. PRAM.L tracks an equal-weighted index of global companies related to the photonics and memory industry, including data storage drives and memory semiconductors. PRAM was launched on Aug 26, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
